verdict.rationale: CSC documents same-day electronic delivery of time-stamped service-of-process documents to designated contacts based on routing preferences, which replaces waiting on a physical mail batch. The docs promise same-day delivery, not an instant alert, and the email alerts they describe cover compliance-calendar and good-standing changes, not SOP. missing for 10: an explicit immediate or real-time alert (email, SMS or push) triggered when a lawsuit is received, documented delivery-time guarantees beyond 'same-day', and independent or hands-on corroboration of how fast notification actually arrives.

support.subject: As a founder, a lawsuit or other time-sensitive legal notice triggers an immediate notification rather than waiting on a mail batch

citations.quote: Same-day, secure scanning, compressing, and delivery of SOP documents
Each file is time stamped and delivered electronically
We'll receive, scan, and deliver your SOP according to your routing preferences and designated contacts.
